lesson: Do not turn inherited press labels or a prior-tournament captaincy into near certainty for a new official designation. Include veteran starters whom the coach may choose for leadership continuity; Tim Ream was a realistic captain branch even though Tyler Adams carried the stronger public label.

Distinguish product classes before mapping an operating system. RTX personal AI PCs belong primarily to the Windows ecosystem, whereas DGX workstations suggest Linux or DGX OS. Also forecast the requested answer family (Windows) rather than over-specific version labels when the criterion is broad.
